keywords: Revision – Bail – Heroin – 1,300 grams allegedly recovered, Government Analyst reporting 480.92 grams pure heroin – High Court refusing bail without recording reasons – Judicial discretion – Delay in seeking revision – Exceptional circumstances – Fair trial – Factors governing bail – Arbitrary exercise of discretion through failure to give reasons – Grave miscarriage of justice – High Court order set aside – High Court directed to reconsider bail application afresh and give reasons – Revision allowed without costs. L.T.B. Dehideniya J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 138; Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – section 404; Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1984 – sections 54A(b), 54A(c) and 83(1); Bail Act.
